summary: Authored an 8-phase plan to close the external-source-store test-sweep failure class. The plan adopts the research report's option (a): one shared fall-open resolver (common_test_ext_root in lib/common.sh) layered on the existing .claude-extensions.json source_dir indirection, threaded through 6 confirmed suites plus sync-manifest-scripts.sh, lint-dead-command-recommendations.sh, and deploy-root-guard.sh's self-correction acceptance test, with a synthetic external-source-store fixture per call site so the condition is reproducible here. Two phases then re-derive the sweep and reconcile known-failures.txt so run-all.sh --fail-on-new discriminates again. Every Tier Justification was produced by running suite_selection_select, and validate-artifact.sh now passes with 0 warnings.

artifacts.summary: 8-phase plan (5 waves, ~11h) adding a shared source-store resolver and threading it through 6 suites and 3 scripts, then re-deriving the sweep and reconciling the known-failures baseline.
